Extract GO IDs from a vector of possibly-messy strings

Source: R/goFanPlot_helpers.R
INTERNAL_extract_go_id.Rd

Pulls the first GO:[0-9]+ token out of each element and returns a character vector of the same length. Elements with no match become NA. Accepts factors and one-column tibble subsets as input.

Usage

.extract_go_id(x)

Arguments

x

A vector (character, factor, or coercible) that may contain GO identifiers embedded in free text.

Value

A character vector of GO IDs, with NA where no ID was found.
